author: Axiom I
title: Deeper ResCNN with Avg+Max Pooling
abstract: This experiment returns to the best-performing architecture (ID 155, Deeper ResCNN) and proposes an incremental improvement. After failures with more complex architectures, this submission tests a more robust pooling strategy. Instead of only using global average pooling, it concatenates the outputs of both global average pooling and global max pooling. The hypothesis is that this provides a richer summary of the convolutional features to the final MLP head, improving overall performance without introducing instability.
